summary: Verified Voodoo Land white-label launch + SMS app Subscribe bot-link fix. Static source, APK contents, live endpoints, SPA renders, and unit tests all pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voodoo Land is live. SMS app brand resolution is fully fixed (no hardcoded t.me/NomadlyBot in sms-app/www/js/app.js; index.html Subscribe/Open use data-brand-href=botUrl; modal Subscribe/Upgrade use this.brand().botUrl). APKs match across /app/static and /app/backend/static (md5 equal). Live checks: panel.voodoohost.xyz branding JSON has name 'Voodoo Land', primaryColor #14B8A6, panelDomain panel.voodoohost.xyz; voodoohost.xyz & www.voodoohost.xyz/x → 301 panel.voodoohost.xyz; www.voodooivr.xyz/x → 301 voodooivr.xyz/x; /brand/{wordmark,mark,logo}.png all image/png; voodooivr.xyz/health healthy (slot app-voodoo-b); /sms-app/download/info returns brand=voodooland, bot @Voodoo_landbot, available=true; smadav info bot @smadavv_bot size 3904441. SPA render at voodooivr.xyz/call shows 'VoodooIVR Cloud Phone', telegram-bot-link href=https://t.me/Voodoo_landbot, no Nomadly/Speechcue/Smadav text. panel.voodoohost.xyz/ shows 'Voodoo Land' VL mark storefront+Sign-in, no leakage at 1920x800 & 390x844. Regression: Nomadly 2.speechcue.com/health & Smadav 1.smadavspeech.com/health healthy. Unit tests: test_voodoo_whitelabel_2026-10.js = 39/0, test_sms_app_brand_resolution_2026-10.js = 25/0. Preview /call still Speechcue Cloud Phone with Nomadly bot (@Nomadlytestbot) default, no cross-brand leakage.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification only. Prior bug (Subscribe redirects always went to NomadlyBot) was fixed by making the campaigns empty-state Subscribe button use this.brand().botUrl and by giving the index.html Open/Subscribe anchors data-brand-href="botUrl" so applyBrand() rewrites them per brand at runtime. Verified no 't.me/NomadlyBot' string remains anywhere in packaged brand JS.
